details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:3321-3322 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: `_list_integration_conflict_files` probes `git merge-tree` in a way that always returns 1 under `set -euo pipefail`, so the hot-file short-circuit never triggers.
  WHY: Every reviewer who checked it said `git merge-tree` exits non-zero with no args, and pipefail makes the help-text grep irrelevant.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:3420-3422 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The hot-file conflict count relies on `wc -l` output that these reviewers said can break the arithmetic test.
  WHY: minimax/moonshot/x-ai reported `integer expression expected` / counting failures, while deepseek explicitly debunked it as clean numeric output.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:5462-5490 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The managed conflict-override path increments `conflict_override_count[head_sha]` before `_dispatch_review_for_conflicts` has confirmed a new dispatch.
  WHY: Reviewers agreed that an already-active resolver (rc=2) still advances the budget-neutral counter, burning allowance on observations rather than new work.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:7126-7147 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The standalone conflict-override path persists the override count before dispatch outcome is known, so repeated observations of the same in-flight resolver still consume budget-neutral allowance.
  WHY: Multiple reviewers said rc=2 / dispatch-failure cases still advance the counter; no reviewer disputed the standalone manifestation.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:5854-5925, 6144-6149 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The judge cache key hashes `recent_comments`, so the poller’s own Stall Judge comment changes the key and prevents replay hits from accumulating.
  WHY: Reviewers agreed the next poll tick sees a different `recent_comments_hash`, so `MAX_JUDGE_REPLAY` never reaches its cap.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:6067-6117 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The replay-cap path writes `escalate_human`, but normalization maps it back to the phase fallback when human terminalization is disabled.
  WHY: Reviewers agreed the intended terminal escape hatch is silently downgraded under the default configuration.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:7098-7104 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The standalone `ai:done` path uses the wrong recovery ceiling, so it stops after the global per-issue cap instead of the intended `MAX_STALL_RECOVERIES_DONE`.
  WHY: moonshot/qwen/x-ai reported premature termination at 5 recoveries, while deepseek called it pre-existing/not a last-run regression.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:7140-7152 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The `_std_consume_budget` jq mutation lacks the `|| echo "${updated_state}"` fallback, so jq failure can blank persisted standalone state.
  WHY: All three reviewers who flagged this said the conversion can drop recovery counters/timestamps on malformed input or jq failure.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:7415-7427, 7438, 7504-7516 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The other converted standalone jq writebacks also omit the fallback, so a jq error can erase the newly built state before persistence.
  WHY: Reviewers cited the close-and-reissue and post-action writebacks as vulnerable to empty-state writes, although they grouped the affected line ranges differently.
- scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh:729-782 and 812-859 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5]
  PROBLEM: The per-attempt timeout default/validate/clamp logic is duplicated in two near-identical blocks.
  WHY: Both reviewers said the copy-paste duplication is a maintenance hazard even though it does not fail at runtime.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:7151-7152, 7425-7426, 7438-7439, 7514-7515 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: The new jq blocks leave stray `"` terminators and inconsistent indentation around the block closures.
  WHY: minimax and moonshot treated the artifacts as maintainability issues, while deepseek and z-ai said the quotes are syntactically required / not syntax errors.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:3321 | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `_list_integration_conflict_files` capability probe always fails under `set -euo pipefail`.
  WHY: `git merge-tree` with no arguments exits non-zero, so the pipeline status makes the probe return 1 and the hot-file short-circuit never runs.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:5907-5925, 6144-6149 | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The judge cache key self-invalidates after every judge invocation.
  WHY: The cache key hashes `recent_comments`, and the poller posts its own Stall Judge comment afterward, so the next tick sees a different hash and misses the cache.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:6067-6074, 6117 | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The replay-cap path writes `escalate_human`, but normalization can downgrade it back to the fallback action.
  WHY: With `ENABLE_STALL_HUMAN_TERMINALIZATION=false`, the forced escalation is silently mapped to the phase ladder fallback instead of terminating.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:5478-5486, 7141-7147 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `conflict_override_count[head_sha]` is incremented before `_dispatch_review_for_conflicts` returns.
  WHY: An in-flight autofix run that returns rc=2 still burns the budget-neutral allowance even though no new dispatch was launched.
- scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh:729-782 and 812-859 | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Two near-identical `CONFLICT_RESOLVER_PER_ATTEMPT_TIMEOUT_SECS` validation/clamp blocks are duplicated.
  WHY: The copy-paste duplication is a maintenance hazard because the blocks can diverge even though the current runtime behavior is the same.
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:3321 | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `_list_integration_conflict_files` capability probe always fails under `set -euo pipefail`.
  WHY: `git merge-tree` without arguments exits non-zero, so the pipefail pipeline makes the `if ! ...` check return 1 and disables the hot-file short-circuit.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:6067-6074 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The replay-cap path writes `escalate_human`, but normalization can downgrade it back to the fallback.
  WHY: When human terminalization is disabled, `normalize_stall_recovery_action` maps the forced escalation back to the phase fallback and the terminal escape hatch never fires.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:5479-5481, 7139-7147 | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `conflict_override_count[head_sha]` is incremented before dispatch success is confirmed.
  WHY: If `_dispatch_review_for_conflicts` returns rc=2 because a resolver is already active, the counter still advances and consumes budget-neutral allowance without a new dispatch.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:5924-5925 | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The judge cache key includes `recent_comments_hash`, which changes after each judge post.
  WHY: After `invoke_stall_judge` posts its own comment, the next tick hashes different `recent_comments`, so the cache misses and the replay cap cannot accumulate.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:3420 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: `wc -l` output may cause arithmetic test issues.
  WHY: The hot-file count check can trip on the command output and fail the guard even when conflicts are present.
- scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh:752-782 and 835-859 | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Duplicate `CONFLICT_RESOLVER_PER_ATTEMPT_TIMEOUT_SECS` default/validate/clamp blocks.
  WHY: The duplicated logic is redundant and can diverge later, creating confusing maintenance bugs.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:7151-7152, 7425-7426, 7438-7439, 7514-7515 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Stray `"` characters remain after jq block closures.
  WHY: The reviewers considered the artifacts cosmetic/maintainability issues; bash syntax still passes.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===

  PROBLEM: The new jq blocks have mixed tabs/spaces and stray `"` characters on standalone lines.
  WHY: The reviewer treated this as a formatting/maintainability issue, not a syntax failure.
